messages:
maya: Observed a weird flow: tenant A reconnects, resumes an opaque session, but the request hits fallback region and gets a new session id. Client retries and we end up with two active sessions until KV cache invalidation. Seeing doubled token/billing in console. Anyone seen this?

sam: Hmm, do you have logs? Is it only when routing switches region or also when instance pool rebalances?

maya: Mostly cross-region failover. Snippet:
```
INFO resume_attempt tenant=tenant-A session=opaque_0x9f resume_ok=false fallback_region=eu-west1
INFO new_session tenant=tenant-A session=opaque_0x1a created_by=fallback
```
Then client sends queued tokens and both sessions accept. Token usage shows up twice in console per-second charts.

eli: That sounds like a resume idempotency gap. We currently accept resume if timestamp <= last_seen+5s. If routing causes replay to a new host that hasn't seen the KV, it creates a new session.

lina: Can we tighten the resume window or make resume include a monotonic nonce validated by the control plane? But that adds an RPC on resume fast-path.

sam: Also check our billing aggregation; console merges by tenant+session id, so two session ids => double-charges. We should either dedupe on client nonce or make resume return canonical session id and the client updates it before flushing tokens.

maya: Client doesn't always support update mid-stream. We have cases with browser reconnect + queued messages.

ops-bot: deploy 1718729400: routing sticky-lease tweak rolled to canary on eu-west1 (lina)

eli: Can we add a fallback-only guard: when a host creates a session from resume with unknown KV, mark it as 'tentative' and refuse token acceptance until it confirms KV with origin host or control-plane handshake? That prevents double-acceptance but adds ~10ms on fallback.

lina: For UX in console, we should add an 'inconsistent sessions' alert that spots sessions with overlapping token timestamps and same client_ip. That would help debug tenant reports quickly.

sam: Short-term mitigation: reduce resume acceptance window to 1s for cross-region resumes and set a console flag that automatically collapses matched sessions for billing reports for the last-minute window.

maya: I'll open a tiny RFC for the tentative-session handshake. Also adding a console filter story for 'collapse probable duplicates' so SREs can revert billing spikes without changing runtime.

eli: +1. Can you add telemetry fields: resume_origin_region, tentative=true/false so console can filter? That will make queries easier.

maya: Yep. Adding to RFC and will tag owners. Thanks all :raised_hands:
